summary: Verified all 4 user-reported bug fixes on InfraJagat web preview at 390x844: (1) app rename to InfraJagat, (2) no overlap between properties count and Trending localities, (3) heart/like on pin preview with save/unsave, (4) OTP verification flow. All fixes work as specified. Deprecated packages detected: none; SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Minor observation: on the very first heart tap immediately after fresh OTP login, the Saved tab briefly showed 0 (probable auth/context race). Subsequent taps toggle correctly and property appears/disappears in Saved.

integration_issues.flow: First heart tap after fresh OTP login → Saved tab
integration_issues.issue: On the very first heart tap after fresh onboarding+OTP, navigating to Saved sometimes shows Properties · 0. A subsequent tap on the same pin correctly saves and shows in Saved. Likely a race between auth-context user propagation and toggleSave's early-return (`if (!user) return`). Consider awaiting user or persisting auth before enabling the heart button.

action_items: Optional: harden PinPreview.toggleSave to await user hydration (e.g., disable the heart when !user, or store optimistic save and retry when user arrives). Current flow works on second attempt.

Address console deprecation warnings (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props should migrate to boxShadow, 'textShadow*' to textShadow, and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents. These originate from theme shadow helpers and vendored components.
critical_code_review_comments: otp.tsx: verify() uses `useAuth().setUser` correctly and calls /api/auth/onboard only after correct OTP — matches spec.
explore.tsx sheetHeader: correctly conditional renders back-chip+SELECTED when a pin is selected in map view, hiding the Map/List toggle.
pin-preview.tsx no longer renders any pin-preview-close testID; heart button (pin-preview-like) sits top-right with hitSlop=10 and proper accessibility label.
seed_data_creation: None; used pre-seeded properties (₹72 L Bagru plot).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full E2E on web preview at 390x844 passed: onboarding → /otp (wrong 1234 shows otp-error, correct 0000 advances) → /explore with Hi, Rahul → tap ₹72 L pin → pin-preview-back + SELECTED visible, no toggle, no pin-preview-close, pin-preview-like visible → heart tap saves → Saved tab lists property → tap heart again toggles state. One minor race on the very first save attempt post-OTP; subsequent attempts consistent.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all 4 fixes verified. The transient first-tap-shows-0-in-Saved observation is likely due to auth-context user not yet being propagated to PinPreview at the moment of the tap, causing toggleSave's `if (!user) return` early-exit. UI heart state still flips optimistically, producing the perceived inconsistency.
